name: Wild Hunt Enchantress
body:
Wild Hunt Enchantress
CR 20

This staggeringly beautiful woman wearing only a diaphanous dress seems to move with such grace that she seems to be floating. Translucent, arcane tattoos twist, wind and turn upon her delicate skin, almost as pale as her cascading, snowy hair. Her milkywhite eyes look upon you with a seductive but dangerous stare, and when the light hits right, you can almost see an ethereal outline of elegant elk antlers crowning her head.

XP 307,200
CN Medium fey (wild hunt)
Init +13; Senses greater arcane sight, greensight 60 ft., low-light vision, mistsight, scent, see in darkness, true seeing; Perception +41

DEFENSE

AC 36, touch 31, flat-footed 26 (+11 deflection, +9 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural)
hp 315 (30d6+210); regeneration 10 (cold iron)
Fort +17, Ref +27, Will +25; +8 vs. mind-affecting
Defensive Abilities freedom of movement, instinctive cooperation, wild grace
DR 15/cold iron; Immune cold; Resist electricity 10, fire 10; SR 31

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee accursed touch +25 (10d8/19-20)
Special Attacks enchanting gaze, wild gaze (DC 36)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th; concentration +31)

Constant—freedom of movement, greater arcane sight, know direction, mind blank, speak with animals, speak with plants, truespeak, true seeing
At will—bestow curse (DC 27), charm monster (DC 27), command (DC 24), dimension door, dominate person (DC 28), ghost sound (DC 21), hold monster (DC 28) major image (DC 24)
3/day—break enchantment, greater command (DC 28), hallucinatory terrain (DC 25), mass suggestion (DC 29), plane shift (DC 28), stone tell, veil
1/day—dominate monster (DC 32), greater bestow curse (DC 31), mass charm monster (DC 31), mass hold monster (DC 32), wind walk

Spells Prepared (CL 20th; concentration +31)

9th—foresight, mass suffocation (DC 32), polar midnight (DC 30), shapechange, winds of vengeance
8th—death clutch (DC 31), finger of death (DC 31), horrid wilting (DC 31), mass atavism, maze
7th—baleful shadow transmutation (DC 28), control weather, fire storm (DC 28), harm (DC 30), heal, waves of exhaustion
6th—cone of cold (DC 27), greater dispel magic (2), move earth, transport via plants, wither limb (DC 29)
5th—baleful polymorph (DC 26), call lightning storm (DC 26), death ward, feeblemind (DC 28), mind fog (DC 28), siphon magic
4th—air walk, black tentacles, confusion (DC 27), cure serious wounds, greater false life, mass daze (DC 27), strong jaw
3rd—cure moderate wounds, debilitating pain (DC 26), deep slumber (DC 26), dispel magic (2), heroism, wind wall
2nd—cat’s grace, boneshaker (3, DC 25), ironskin, lesser restoration, resist energy
1st—cure light wounds (3), entangle (DC 22), faerie fire, long arm, mage armor
0th—detect magic, guidance, mending, stabilize

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 29, Con 24, Int 24, Wis 26, Cha 33
Base Atk +15; CMB +18; CMD 49
Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Dodge, Dimensional Agility, Empower Spell, Greater Spell Focus (enchantment, necromancy), Improved Critical (touch), Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Quicken Spell, Spell Focus (enchantment, necromancy), Vital Strike, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (touch)
Skills Acrobatics +42, Bluff +44, Diplomacy +44, Intimidate +41, Knowledge (arcana, planes) +37, Knowledge (geography, nature) +40, Perception +41, Spellcraft +37, Sense Motive +41, Use Magic Device +44
Languages Aklo, Common, Draconic, Sylvan; speak with animals, speak with plants, truespeak
SQ planar acclimation, wild hunt link, wild empathy +49

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Accursed Touch (Su)

A wild hunt enchantress’ touch drains the life force of its targets. Damage caused by the accursed touch ignores damage reduction, but damage it deals to objects and nonliving creatures is halved. After a successful hit, she gains temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt. They do not stack and disappear 1 hour later. A wild hunt enchantress can also deliver touch spells and spell-like abilities through her accursed touch without forgoing its damage, similar to the spellstrike ability of a magus.

Enchanting Gaze (Su)

When a creature fails the Will save against the wild gaze of a wild hunt enchantress, she can forgo its normal effects to cast a spell or a spell-like ability belonging to the enchantment school upon this creature as an immediate action.

Spellcasting

A wild hunt enchantress casts prepared arcane spells as a 20th level witch and has access to all spells from the druid and witch spell lists. The wild hunt enchantress uses Charisma as her key spellcasting ability score.

Wild Empathy (Ex)

This ability works like the druid ability of the same name. The wild hunt enchantress’ total bonus includes a +8 racial bonus.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary, dance (1 plus a wild hunt monarch), or retinue (1 plus 1-4 wild hunt daughters)
Treasure double

A wild hunt enchantress is an atypical member of the group, starting with the fact that she is rarely seen with the rest of those dangerous fey. The enchantresses are not a part of a traditional wild hunt, and as such are rarely associated with it. Still, a cursory look over their abilities reveals common traits betraying their ostensible allegiance to the group, for example their ability to acclimate to all planes they visit or their participation in the wild hunt link, though enchantresses never share any abilities with others. Contact between the enchantresses and the rest of the hunt is most often limited to the enchantress sometimes lending them the assistance of her powerful magic or her formidable abilities in crafting magic items. Such contact is always conducted through the hunt’s monarch, who is expected to formally ask for assistance and pay a customary price. While this tribute is most often small and unimportant, like bringing the enchantress some magical components or organizing a lavish banquet, some enchantresses caught in a particular mood or feeling strongly about the individual monarch may hike those prices much higher, for example expecting the monarch to organize a hunt against her dangerous rival.

The incredible beauty of wild hunt enchantresses, rivaling that of nymphs but markedly more refined, places them squarely in the upper echelons of the vain fey even disregarding the incredibly powerful magic they wield. Wild hunt enchantresses wield mastery over supernatural forces that is seldom matched throughout the planes, easily bending forces of nature to their will and seamlessly blending them with arcane magic. They specialize in mind-breaking enchantments and lifedestroying curses, and a wild hunt enchantress can easily drop a whole group of creatures to their knees or murder them within seconds. Only the most powerful extraplanar beings and even fewer mortal spellcasters can match the enchantress in either knowledge or proficiency with magic. Wild hunt enchantresses spend most time in the primal homeworld of the fey, having little interest in the material world.

They most commonly live alone in magical, sprawling mansions, but occasionally join courts of the most powerful fey as seemingly disinterested, but sharp advisors.

A wild hunt enchantress, despite its outward allegiance to the group, exceedingly rarely accompanies others when they ride. Instead, she sometimes loans out creatures she calls her “daughters”. These women are nearly identical to their mistress, but a bit imperfect in every aspect. Physically, intellectually, in beauty and in magic, every single one of them resembles the wild hunt enchantress but very slightly flawed. These fey creatures are not actual, biological daughters of the enchantress, but more like her clones or simulacra. More disturbingly, it is known that if the wild hunt enchantress is slain while any of her daughters still live, she will return in the body of one, regaining her full powers and appearance in mere days, even if slain outside of her home plane.

Wild hunt enchantresses have a great bond with fauna and are able to summon scores of creatures with powerful magic. Most have no need to do that, as almost every wild hunt enchantress possesses a vast menagerie of animals and magical creatures, as enamored with her as any humanoid man would be. Those creatures would do anything to help and protect their mistress and enchantresses like to use them not only as pets, but also as deadly guards. Of course, the feeling is not mutual, and an enchantress would gladly sacrifice them all to save her life or forward a scheme. Enchantresses are known for sometimes anthropomorphizing their pets via magic if there ever comes a need for more servants than their usual retinue.

As regal as they are beautiful, wild hunt enchantresses see all suitors as beneath them and often use terrible magic to punish those thinking themselves worthy to court them. Even powerful fey, like glaistigs or erlkings, are seen as inferior and shunned aside. The only matches whose advances the enchantresses tolerate are those made by wild hunt monarchs. A king or queen of a wild hunt, if especially charming and successful, may even sometimes succeed in gaining the enchantress’ attention. Most of the time, after a prolonged back and forth, the enchantress will reward the monarch by granting them one of her “daughters” as a consort and a permanent addition to the wild hunt. In the rarest cases, an actual romance between the monarch and enchantress will ensue, always intense but often brief, for it takes a truly exceptional individual to keep the interest of a wild hunt enchantress.

Wild hunt enchantresses are always female and appear as lithe and beautiful humanoids with elvish features, young as if they barely came of age. Their skin is almost always pale but their hair can vary from pure white, through shining gold and fiery red, all the way to raven black. Their eyes are unicolor, with no pupil or iris, and most often milk-white, but sometimes of other, always intense, color. They tend to dress in light but beautiful clothes underlining their beauty and sometimes choose not to dress at all. Most enchantresses have some level of dark shade marring their otherwise perfectly fair skin. This supernatural shadow looks like something between a frostbite or a skin condition and actual twisting, umbral wisps. The coverage of this phenomenon varies, ranging from just fingertips to reaching beyond the elbows and almost to their shoulders, though never spreading to the torso or beyond. Some enchantresses wear it proudly and some hide it behind layered glamers and illusions.

It is speculated that this shadow is what grants the enchantresses the life-draining quality of their touch, something that they can use to great effect but is otherwise more often a hindrance than a boon, especially to those less skilled at controlling its deadly effects.

An average wild hunt enchantress is just under 6 feet tall and weighs 110 pounds.

A Wild Hunt Daughter (CR 17) is a wild hunt enchantress with the degenerate creature simple template, 25 HD, fast healing instead of regeneration and casts spells as a 17th level witch instead of 20th, though they retain access to the druid spell list.
